column1: # Assigns each measurement file to an experimental condition (group).
#   ProtStatsWF::workflow_QC derives sample groups purely from the intensity
#   column name, by splitting on "_" and taking the FIRST element:
#   Raw measurement names therefore group incorrectly on their own
#   (e.g. "FLI04006" would become its own one-sample group). This file maps
#   each file to a condition so the intensity columns can be renamed to
#   * One row per measurement file, TAB-separated, exactly two columns.
#   * Column 1 = filename   as the RAW / mzML file is named, WITHOUT extension
#                           (e.g. C1_FLI04006). MUST be identical to the name of the RAW file
#   * Column 2 = condition  the experimental group the file belongs to.
#   * Condition names MUST NOT contain an underscore ("_"), because
#     workflow_QC splits on it to recover the group. Use "C1" or "Control",
#   * Replicate numbers (01, 02, ...) are assigned automatically, in file
#     order within each condition. Do not add them here.
#   * Lines starting with "#" and blank lines are ignored.
#   * Any file left as UNASSIGNED aborts the run with an explicit error,
#   * To add a condition, just append its rows with a new condition name.
